parameters.name: CycleTime
parameters.description:
The days of the cycle.

- If `CycleType` is `Month`, specify the days of the month (1 to 28). Separate multiple days with a comma (,).

- If `CycleType` is `Week`, specify the days of the week (1 to 7). Separate multiple days with a comma (,).

parameters.name: CycleType
parameters.description:
The cycle type of the maintenance window. Valid values:

- `Month`

- `Week`

parameters.name: MaintainEndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the maintenance window, specified in *HH:mm:ss*Z format (UTC time).

parameters.name: MaintainStartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the maintenance window, specified in *HH:mm:ss*Z format (UTC time).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the configuration is enabled. Valid values:

- 1: enabled

- 2: disabled
